questions.question: How does the book of Lamentations begin?
options: 'Arise, shine, for your light has come!'
'Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem, the great joyful city!'
'How lonely sits the city that was full of people!'
questions.answer: 'How lonely sits the city that was full of people!'

questions.question: To what is the once-great city of Jerusalem compared in chapter 1?
options: A mother, rejoicing over her many children
A queen, seated in royal splendor
A widow, weeping bitterly in the night
A bride, adorned for her wedding day
questions.answer: A widow, weeping bitterly in the night

questions.question: Lamentations 1 acknowledges that Jerusalem suffered because of the multitude of her transgressions.
How lonely sits the _____ that was full of people!
Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look and see if there is any _____ like my sorrow.
